task: Paper B (MANUSCRIPT-B.md), Working list item 6: figures for the H1a sensitivity (the single-epoch inversion, §4.2) and the §4.7 seed distribution. Each is generated by a script from locked artifacts, outputs SVG + PNG, with a caption and a placement in the manuscript.
summary_pt:
As duas figuras que o item 6 pede estão prontas. O item 6 não cita nenhuma outra figura. Elas seguem o estilo de fig1–fig3: SVG puro, tokens de cor para claro e escuro (paleta validada com validate_palette.js nos dois modos), guardas que abortam e PNG renderizado pelo Chrome headless a partir do mesmo SVG.

**FigB1 (§4.2).** O painel (a) mostra as horas de sessão por epoch. Elas foram recalculadas importando carregar_episodios + span_por_sessao do pilot_replay.py, e o script aborta se a soma por braço não reproduzir o ITT travado. Reproduziu: 12,70 / 5,16. O painel (b) traz o H1a com o IC de cada perna, lido direto dos JSONs, e o p da re-randomização (0,0855) aparece como texto.

**FigB2 (§4.7).** Histograma das 2 000 sementes do ITEM7-DOSE-TOPO. Antes de desenhar, o script confere se o histograma reproduz P(n=1), P(n≤1), moda e média. Confere também a expectativa 20×39/234, com as contagens do desenho tiradas do próprio assign_arms.py, e o realizado contra o ASSIGNMENT-SERVING.

Os hashes dos insumos batem com o MANIFESTO-LASTRO-P2.json. Os números do texto conferem: §4.1 (as três pernas), §4.2 (12,70/5,16; 7,13 h; 56%; 0,32–0,97 h; sessão d37a5964 com 3 episódios e 6,33 h às 13:52 e 20:12; 74/65/56) e §4.7 (3,333; 3,357; moda 3 com 25,3%; 10,15%; 11,95%).

O que não bate é achado sobre o paper, e está em open_questions:
- **Perna pré-comprometida omitida no §4.2.** Para o H1a, ela também contém zero: −133,34 [−203,62; +7,41]. Ou seja, o IC cruza zero mesmo mantendo o 09-14, e a inversão não é exclusiva daquele epoch.
- **Artefato fora do Apêndice B e do manifesto.** O ITT-SENSIB-PRECOMPROMETIDA.json é a fonte da linha pré-comprometida do §4.1, mas não aparece no Apêndice B, no B.1 nem no manifesto.
- **"9 a 10 minutos" no §4.2.** Medi 8,03–9,71 min.
- **Quotas do §4.7.** 1,0% + 101,0% somam 102%. Com sinal, a quota do truncamento é −1,0%.
- **Sinal do +0,023.** O "+0,023 na direção oposta" está a 0,7 erro-padrão de Monte Carlo (0,0347, calculado do próprio histograma). Rodei uma rechecagem independente com 20 000 sementes, e ela dá −0,007 ± 0,011.
- **O 9,991 do §4.7 não está em artefato nenhum.**

Não rodei git, não toquei VPS e não editei arquivo existente. Não criei _tmp.
not_measured: PNG renderings are light-mode only. The SVGs carry dark-mode tokens (validated with validate_palette.js --mode dark), but no dark PNG was rendered or inspected.

The 2 000-seed ITEM7 run cannot be replayed: its seed recipe is not recorded in ITEM7-DOSE-TOPO-2026-09-21.json, and three guessed recipes (sha256(str(i)), sha256('item7-'+i), random.Random(i)) did not reproduce its histogram. The crosscheck is therefore a second measurement with a declared recipe, not a reproduction.

The `control` conditional mean 9.991 was not verified against an artifact, because none holds it (grep over *.md/*.py/*.json in paper2-interventional and the ~/Backups/paper2-ensaio-2026-09-21/*.json files found it only in MANUSCRIPT-B.md l.724 and DEVIATIONS-FOR-PAPER.md l.3519). It was only corroborated within Monte-Carlo error.

Neither research VPS $NOX_LASTRO_HOST nor production $NOX_PROD_HOST was touched. Everything came from the local ballast ~/Backups/paper2-ensaio-2026-09-21/ and the repo copies of ASSIGNMENT-SERVING.json, pilot_replay.py and assign_arms.py. The input sha256 prefixes match MANIFESTO-LASTRO-P2.json: ITT 19afa7cc2214, ITEM7 08eb7eabb346, RERANDOMIZACAO ee1d4e47a980, episodios bcf451823ea1, ASSIGNMENT-SERVING 8957cc5fe869.
open_questions: §4.2 omits the PRE-COMMITTED sensitivity for H1a. In ITT-SENSIB-PRECOMPROMETIDA.json (partials 09-01, 09-03 and 09-20 removed, 09-14 KEPT), H1a = −133.34, CI [−203.62; +7.41], which CONTAINS zero. The H1a interval therefore crosses zero under the registered sensitivity as well, while the point estimate barely moves (−143.92 → −133.34). The title 'inverts its conclusion on one epoch' and the §4.2 table, which shows only the post-hoc 09-14 leg, are incomplete under the manuscript's own §4.1 rule ('registered sensitivity first'). FigB1 draws all three legs by default; `--sem-precomprometida` drops that row if the author decides otherwise.

ITT-SENSIB-PRECOMPROMETIDA.json (sha256 0191ee5429916f38e5d58391aefc810282ced6ae6cc6e0747be1dc83bff31685, 2 993 bytes, 2026-09-21 16:57) is the only source of the §4.1 'pre-committed sensitivity' row: 0.0721 / 0.0994 / −0.0273 [−0.0725; +0.0061], all verified against it. Yet it is absent from Appendix B, from B.1 and from MANIFESTO-LASTRO-P2.json (20 artifacts), and grep finds 0 mentions of it in MANUSCRIPT-B.md and DEVIATIONS-FOR-PAPER.md. A published number rests on an artifact the ballast does not protect.

§4.2 says the busiest 09-14 sessions produced '74, 65 and 56 episodes in 9 to 10 minutes each'. Measured with pilot_replay's per-(epoch, session) grouping on episodios-ensaio-20260921.jsonl, the spans are 9.71, 8.86 and 8.03 min, so 'in 8 to 10 minutes' is correct. The episode counts 74/65/56 match.

§4.7 table: truncation '+0.023 | 1.0%' plus chance '−2.357 | 101.0%' sums to 102%. With signs (from ITEM7-DOSE-TOPO: 0.0232 / −2.3333 and −2.3565 / −2.3333), the shares are −1.0% and +101.0%, which sum to 100%. The truncation share should read −1.0%, or the text should say it opposes the deficit by 1.0%. FigB2 prints '(−1.0% of it)'.

§4.7 says 'Conditioning moves the expectation by +0.023 — and in the direction opposite to the intuition'. The Monte-Carlo standard error of the 2 000-seed conditional mean, computed from the artifact's own histogram, is 0.0347, so +0.023 is 0.7 s.e. from zero and its SIGN is not resolved. An independent 20 000-seed redraw with assign_arms.assign and the declared recipe SHA256('sprint-figB-item7-crosscheck|<i>') gives a w7.5 conditional mean of 3.3264 ± 0.0108, i.e. truncation −0.007 ± 0.011, the opposite sign, also indistinguishable from zero. The conclusion (truncation is negligible, |effect| ≲ 0.03, about 1% of the deficit) stands. The direction claim and the '1.0% / 101.0%' precision do not. The same run gives P(n=1) = 9.11% ± 0.20% against the artifact's 10.15% (2 000-seed s.e. ≈ 0.68%, 1.5 s.e. apart), which is consistent but suggests the title-level '10.15%' carries roughly ±0.7 pp of MC noise.

§4.7's 'conditional mean for control is 9.991 against 9 realized' has no artifact: it exists only in DEVIATIONS-FOR-PAPER.md l.3519, and B.1 attributes the §4.7 numbers to ITEM7-DOSE-TOPO-2026-09-21.json, which holds only the w7.5 distribution. The 20 000-seed crosscheck gives 10.0124 ± 0.0146 for control, consistent with 9.991 within the MC error of a 2 000-seed run (≈ 0.046), but the number is not traceable. Either add the control distribution to the artifact or cite the crosscheck JSON.
The seed recipe of the 2 000-seed ITEM7 run is not recorded in the artifact, unlike RERANDOMIZACAO's seed_prefix. Should it be declared in Appendix B, as the re-randomization's is?
proposed_text_en:
=== FIGURE B1 — insert in §4.2, after the paragraph ending "…a conclusion that turns on one sparse session is not a conclusion." and immediately before "### 4.3 H1 — an interval excluding zero that is not a finding" ===

![Figure B1](figures/figB1-h1a-inversao.svg)

**Figure B1 — H1a turns on one epoch because the exposure denominator counts idle time.** (a) Session-hours per epoch, by designated arm, as the registered estimator computes them: for each session, the span between its first and last event, summed per epoch (`span_por_sessao`, imported from `pilot_replay.py`). Nineteen epochs fall between 0.32 and 0.97 h. `2026-09-14` (treatment, w = 4) has 7.13 h, which is 56% of all treatment exposure (12.70 h over 11 epochs, against 5.16 h over 9 control epochs). Almost all of it comes from one session with three episodes spanning 6.33 h, while the epoch's three busiest sessions logged 74, 65 and 56 episodes within 8.0–9.7 min each. (b) The H1a difference, treatment − control in opportunities per session-hour, with its 95% cluster-bootstrap interval (epoch as the unit, 10 000 replicates, seed 20260921) under three legs. The locked leg excludes zero: −143.92 [−209.80; −15.34]. The pre-committed sensitivity, which removes the three partial epochs and keeps 09-14, contains zero: −133.34 [−203.62; +7.41]. So does the post-hoc sensitivity, chosen after seeing the data, which removes 09-14: −63.04 [−120.45; +1.76]. Filled marker: the interval excludes zero; hollow marker: it contains zero. Every interval here under-covers (§4.1.1, §4.4.1). The registered re-randomization test, a different estimand (§4.0.2), gives p = 0.0855 and does not reject. Sources: panel (a) from `episodios-ensaio-20260921.jsonl` and `ASSIGNMENT-SERVING.json`; the script aborts unless the per-arm sums reproduce `horas_sessao` in `ITT-2026-09-21.json`. Panel (b) from `ITT-2026-09-21.json`, `ITT-SENSIB-PRECOMPROMETIDA.json` and `RERANDOMIZACAO-2026-09-21.json`. Generated by `measurement/sprint-figB-h1a-inversao.py`.

[If the author does not add the pre-committed leg to the §4.2 table, regenerate with `--sem-precomprometida` and drop the sentence about the pre-committed sensitivity from this caption. See open questions.]

=== FIGURE B2 — insert in §4.7, after the paragraph "Conditional mean 3.357, mode 3 (25.3%), `P(n = 1) = 10.15%`, … truncation does not displace that either." and before "**Why truncation cannot bias here:**" ===

![Figure B2](figures/figB2-sementes-dose-topo.svg)

**Figure B2 — One epoch at the top dose is a tail draw, not a truncation effect.** Distribution of n, the number of the 20 realized epochs assigned w = 7.5, over 2 000 designs re-drawn with the published `assign_arms.py` and conditioned on the same dates. The realized n = 1 (highlighted) has probability 10.15%, and P(n ≤ 1) = 11.95%. The mode is 3 (25.3%). The dashed line is the design expectation 20 × 39/234 = 3.333; the dotted line is the conditional mean, 3.357. The two lines are 0.023 apart, which is 0.7 Monte-Carlo standard errors (s.e. 0.035 over 2 000 seeds, computed from the histogram). Conditioning on the realized dates therefore moves the expectation by an amount whose sign this run does not resolve. The whole deficit of −2.333 is chance; truncation accounts for about 1% of it in magnitude. With n = 1 at the top dose, there is no dose-response to read (analysis spec §7). Source: `ITEM7-DOSE-TOPO-2026-09-21.json`. The script aborts unless the histogram reproduces the artifact's summary fields, the design counts (39 of 234) come from `assign_arms.py`, and the realized count matches `ASSIGNMENT-SERVING.json`. Generated by `measurement/sprint-figB-sementes-dose-topo.py`.

=== Appendix B — rows to add (table "artifacts") ===

| `ITT-SENSIB-PRECOMPROMETIDA.json` | the pre-committed sensitivity leg (§9.1 of the spec: all partials removed) — source of the §4.1 row and of Figure B1(b) |
| `sprint-figB-h1a-inversao.py` · `sprint-figB-sementes-dose-topo.py` | Figures B1 and B2, regenerated from the artifacts above; each aborts if its plotted values diverge from the locked JSON |
| `figB2-item7-crosscheck-20000.json` · `sprint-figB-item7-crosscheck.py` | an independent 20 000-seed redraw (declared seed recipe) corroborating §4.7 within Monte-Carlo error; not a reproduction of the 2 000-seed run, whose seed recipe was not recorded |

=== Suggested text corrections tied to the figures (author's decision; see open questions) ===
- §4.2: "in 9 to 10 minutes each" → "in 8 to 10 minutes each".
- §4.7 table: truncation share "1.0%" → "−1.0%".
- §4.7: "Conditioning moves the expectation by +0.023 — and in the direction opposite to the intuition." → "Conditioning moves the expectation by +0.023, which is 0.7 Monte-Carlo standard errors from zero (s.e. 0.035 over 2 000 seeds); its sign is not resolved, and an independent 20 000-seed redraw gives −0.007 ± 0.011. Truncation accounts for about 1% of the deficit in magnitude, in either direction."
